text:
Alex P: throwing out a different format for the next webinar: 45m speedrun demos (3 x 10m), then 30m split: 15m office-hours for adoption + 15m hands-on mini-lab. goal is higher intent mapping at sign-up. what do people think?

Nia: sounds promising. speedruns lower attention friction. curious about sign-up segmentation: ask which demo people care about and whether they want office hours.

Tomas: agree. for demos we should name them clearly: "Fast infra: routing & pre-warm", "Cost quick wins", "Integrations in 10m". each demo needs 1 speaker + 1 demo engineer on standby.

Meera: office-hours logistics: limit to 50 seats and require RSVP to reduce no-shows. for the lab, provide a pre-install checklist and a small sample repo. no creds in notebooks.

Alex P: signup form idea: two-field capture -> (1) preferred demo (multi-select), (2) interest: office-hours / lab / watch-only. use hidden form param for "ok to share logs" for routing to solutions.

Nia: measurement: track conversion per flow (sign-up -> attended -> trial start). target: 20% uplift in trial opt-ins from demo-interested folks.

Tomas: rehearsal plan:
```
- 30m speaker dry run (slides + demo order)
- 30m full run with demo engineer + moderator handoffs
- 15m fallback video check
- 15m calendar/webinar platform check (polls, chat moderation)
```

Meera: poll ideas during webinar:
1) Which area are you optimizing now? (cost, latency, reliability, integration)
2) Would you sign up for a trial? (yes/maybe/no)
3) Interested in a dedicated follow-up? (sales/solutions/technical office-hours)

Alex P: good. add a final quick NPS-style question: "How useful was the webinar? (0-10)". we will wire that into the post event email for segmentation.

Tomas: fallback content: record 3x2min demo clips and a 5min office-hours summary. store them on our CDN and have direct links ready in case streaming hiccups.

Meera: lab prep checklist (short):
- public sample repo: github.com/redwood/infer-lab-quickstart
- docker image with env var guidance (NO_SECRETS)
- one-click hosted notebook option (auth via SSO)
- troubleshooting doc for support volunteers

Alex P: for lead routing: map preferred demo -> SDR specialty (infra -> infra SDR, cost -> product/value SDR, integrations -> solutions SDR). lab RSVPs go to solutions + an engineer follow-up.

Nia: volunteers? need 3 support engineers, 1 chat moderator, 1 data wrangler for live metrics. I'll take the moderator role.

Tomas: I'll roster Dan and Priya for support engineering.

Meera: I'll handle the pre-records and the mini-lab repo. can someone make the signup page copy?

Alex P: @Jenna (cc marketing ops) can you draft copy and the three poll questions in the webinar platform?

DevOps-bot: Tip: verify CDN signed-url expiry >= 7 days for rehearsal assets.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Webinar: Speedrun + Office Hours" on 2025-08-12 17:00 UTC. Rehearsal slot: 2025-08-10 16:00 UTC.

Nia: timeline: copy + signup by Mon, pre-records by next Tue, rehearsals on Aug 10, final check Aug 12 morning.

Tomas: small ask on the signup form: add an optional field "primary cloud & instance type" to help us tailor follow-ups (GCP/AWS/Azure). short dropdown.

Meera: agreed. also add a brief pre-webinar email with 2-min "what to install" so lab attendees can be ready.

Alex P: great thread. last bit: we'll track two KPIs: trial opt-in rate by demo and office-hours RSVP -> conversion. keep the thread for volunteer confirmations only from here on. thanks all :rocket:
